title: MLflow
description: Documented public ML lifecycle platform (Databricks / LF (open source)) for the Training Pipeline Generator capability area.
body:
MLflow is a documented ML lifecycle platform from Databricks / LF (open source). The open standard for experiment tracking, model registry, and deployment — the pipeline backbone of production ML teams.

How it works: It works by simulating an exponentially decaying loss curve with noise over the epoch budget and checking convergence.
